quest.title: Treasure Clue: Pudding Isle
quest.description: Go near to the reef of Pudding Isle to see if the pirates have left a clue to the treasure's location there.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2

chapter.title: The Treasure of the Four Skerries

talks.objective: Go to the reef near Pudding Isle

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh... Until the leaves have turned red... This is kinda confusing, {NICKNAME}. Where do they want us to go anyway?

talks.objective: Follow the Route Log to search for the treasure clue

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, Paimon thought we'd found it at last, but it's just like the last time...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Wait until the leaves have turned red and yellow, then dock on the island from the west. You will be able to see a tower."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon's got it! A tower... This can only mean one thing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks like we've gotta change the mountains so they look like that, {NICKNAME}.

talks.objective: Follow the Route Log to search for the treasure clue
